newsitem.title: USA: CBOT nearby rice ends limit down on exports, funds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT nearby rice ends limit down on exports, funds.

text.p: CBOT May rice futures ended down the 30-cent per cwt limit on Thursday, pressured by relatively light USDA weekly export sales and heavy fund sales, traders said.
"Export numbers weren't very good," a trader said. "Stops were hit below $11.27 (in the May). Locals weren't willing to bid it back up."
USDA on Thursday put weekly rice exports at 21,400 tonnes, down 70 percent from the previous week and 45 percent below the four-week average.
"You had a market that was fundamentally weak and then we hit new fund selling and went limit down," a trader said.
Traders said Refco Inc sold 200 lots on the day.
Rice ended 30 to 18 cents per cwt lower with May down 30 at $11.13-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 1,000 lots, compared with Wednesday's 597 lots.
